flash_sale_reservations_single_order.name: flash_sale_reservations_single_order
flash_sale_reservations_single_order.value:
("flash_sale_reservations"."invoiceId" IS NOT NULL AND "flash_sale_reservations"."transactionId" IS NULL)
      OR ("flash_sale_reservations"."invoiceId" IS NULL AND "flash_sale_reservations"."transactionId" IS NOT NULL)

order_lookup_grants_one_target.name: order_lookup_grants_one_target
order_lookup_grants_one_target.value: ("order_lookup_grants"."invoiceId" IS NOT NULL AND "order_lookup_grants"."transactionId" IS NULL) OR ("order_lookup_grants"."invoiceId" IS NULL AND "order_lookup_grants"."transactionId" IS NOT NULL)

payment_methods_required_fields.name: payment_methods_required_fields
payment_methods_required_fields.value: (("payment_methods"."type" = 'bank_transfer' OR "payment_methods"."type" = 'ewallet') AND "payment_methods"."bankName" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_methods"."accountNumber" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_methods"."accountHolder" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payment_methods"."type" = 'static_qris' AND "payment_methods"."qrImageFile" IS NOT NULL)

promotional_banners_valid_schedule.name: promotional_banners_valid_schedule
promotional_banners_valid_schedule.value: "promotional_banners"."startsAt" IS NULL OR "promotional_banners"."endsAt" IS NULL OR "promotional_banners"."startsAt" < "promotional_banners"."endsAt"

voucher_redemptions_single_order.name: voucher_redemptions_single_order
voucher_redemptions_single_order.value:
("voucher_redemptions"."invoiceId" IS NOT NULL AND "voucher_redemptions"."transactionId" IS NULL)
      OR ("voucher_redemptions"."invoiceId" IS NULL AND "voucher_redemptions"."transactionId" IS NOT NULL)

vouchers_amounts_nonnegative.name: vouchers_amounts_nonnegative
vouchers_amounts_nonnegative.value:
"vouchers"."minOrder" >= 0
      AND "vouchers"."quantityUsed" >= 0
      AND ("vouchers"."maxDiscount" IS NULL OR "vouchers"."maxDiscount" > 0)
      AND ("vouchers"."quotaLimit" IS NULL OR "vouchers"."quotaLimit" >= 0)
      AND ("vouchers"."perUserLimit" IS NULL OR "vouchers"."perUserLimit" > 0)

vouchers_valid_schedule.name: vouchers_valid_schedule
vouchers_valid_schedule.value: "vouchers"."startsAt" IS NULL OR "vouchers"."endsAt" IS NULL OR "vouchers"."startsAt" < "vouchers"."endsAt"
